notebooks.practical_application: A gated educational workflow takes a field team from subsurface uncertainty and single-well limits through count screening, robust producer/injector placement, dynamic reservoir verification, SURF and facility constraints, economics, uncertainty, and an auditable selected concept.
notebooks.issue_handling: No NeqSim, OPM Flow, pymoo, or pyscal defect was found. The notebook states that its synthetic geology and screening economics are teaching inputs and that real decisions require history matching, detailed well design, flow assurance, facility integration, and project-specific assurance.
